description: Candlestick price chart with indicators for a public ticker, such as a daily chart of AAPL with SMA and RSI; for values alone, use get_indicators. Pass symbol as a Yahoo-style ticker: AAPL, BRK-B, EUR/USD, BTC-USD or GOLD (drawn as GC=F); turn a company name into its ticker first (Apple is AAPL). Optional: timeframe (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w; 1d by default), indicators (up to 4 of 12, such as sma, rsi, macd, bollinger or adx; volume is always drawn), periods, lengths (several SMA or EMA lines) and theme. Returns the interactive chart page as html, an openUrl, the last close, the change, high and low over the window, and each indicator value with a plain-language read, the source and as-of time; some clients also show a card. Do not use it for news, fundamentals, earnings, a portfolio, orders, or buy or sell opinions; those need a different source. Public prices only. Informational only, not financial advice.

indicators.description: Up to 4. Volume is always drawn. Defaults to sma and rsi when omitted.

lengths.description: Several SMA or EMA lines on one chart, such as [20, 50] for the 20 and 50 EMA, up to 3. Each length applies to each of sma and ema in indicators, and overrides periods.sma and periods.ema; ignored when neither is in indicators.

periods.description: Lookback per indicator, in bars, such as {"sma": 50}. A period applies only when its indicator is in indicators. MACD stays 12, 26, 9, and VWAP and OBV have no length, so none has an entry.

adx.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when adx is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

atr.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when atr is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

bollinger.description: 20 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when bollinger is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

cci.description: 20 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when cci is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

ema.description: 20 bars by default, at most 200. Used only when ema is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

rsi.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when rsi is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

sma.description: 20 bars by default, at most 200. Used only when sma is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

stochastic.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when stochastic is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

williams_r.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when williams_r is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

symbol.description: Yahoo-style ticker, such as "AAPL". Also accepted: BRK-B, EUR/USD or EURUSD, BTC-USD, BTC/USDT or PEPEUSDT (any coin against USD), GOLD (GC=F), SPX. Turn a company name into its ticker first: Apple is AAPL.

name: chart

asOf.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last bar, or of the call when status is not ok

bars.description: Bars on the chart. 0 when status is not ok.

changePercent.description: Percent change from the previous close to the last close. null when status is not ok.

currency.description: Price currency code from the source, such as USD. Empty when the source gives none.

error.description: Present when status is not ok

hint.description: The next step: what to change or tell the user

html.description: Large: the full chart page, a self-contained interactive HTML document, only when status is ok. Pass it on unchanged, or give the user openUrl instead; never rewrite, shorten or summarize it. Vela attribution stays on.

latest.description: Latest values of the study, in the price currency except RSI, stochastic and ADX (0 to 100), Williams %R (0 to -100), CCI (no fixed range) and OBV (volume)

value.description: sma, ema, rsi, atr, vwap, cci, williams_r and obv value

params.description: Settings used for the study. Empty for vwap and obv.

deviations.description: Bollinger Band width in standard deviations

lastClose.description: Last close in the price currency. null when status is not ok.

notice.description: Not-financial-advice notice. Show it with the read.

openUrl.description: Same chart on chart.openkrill.app, redrawn from public prices

read.description: Plain-language description of the chart. Not financial advice. Empty when status is not ok.

skipped.description: Requested indicators that could not be calculated

reason.description: Why, such as too few bars or no volume

source.description: Price source: Yahoo Finance, Coinbase, or ECB reference rates through Frankfurter. Empty, or the failing source, when status is not ok.

status.description: ok, or why there is no chart; error.hint then says what to do next

symbol.description: Symbol as drawn, such as AAPL, EUR/USD, BTC-USD or GC=F

window.description: The drawn window, only when status is ok: quote these numbers instead of reading the bars. Times are bar open times, ISO 8601 UTC.

changePercent.description: First close to last close, in percent

changes.description: Percent change from the close that many bars back to the last close, for 5, 20 and 60 bars when the window covers them

high.description: Highest high (highest rate on a line chart)

low.description: Lowest low (lowest rate on a line chart)

title: Price chart
